'''Bhuna Sound''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] which joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. To help in the planet's rebuilding efforts, the New Republic sent a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Dewback's Burden]]'', to bring supplies to Bhuna Sound. However, the vessel was attacked by the [[Eiattu pirates|TIE Pirates]], who captured the transport.
